# Crew Messages Rework — Shared Contract

Goal: rebuild `apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/messages.tsx` from "magic button" sends into a broadcast-composer experience (modeled on `apps/wodsmith-start/src/routes/compete/organizer/$competitionId/announcements.tsx`): organizer picks a message type (templated), edits the template, filters/selects recipients with live preview, sends, and sees history. Crew `eventId` IS a `competitionId`.

## New/changed server surface (apps/crew)

### DB schema (packages/wodsmith-db/src/schemas/crew-message-templates.ts, re-exported via apps/crew/src/db/schemas/)

Table `crew_message_templates`:
- commonColumns, id (createCrewMessageTemplateId in common.ts, prefix `cmtpl_`)
- competitionId varchar(255) notNull (FK competitions)
- templateType varchar(64) notNull — one of `assignment_confirmation | reminder_48_hour | reminder_24_hour | custom_broadcast`
- subject varchar(255) notNull
- body text notNull (plain text with `{{variable}}` placeholders, paragraphs split on blank lines)
- unique index (competitionId, templateType)
Export from packages/wodsmith-db schema index like other crew tables. NO manual SQL migrations (drizzle push workflow).

### Default templates (apps/crew/src/lib/crew/message-templates.ts) — pure, unit-testable
- `CREW_MESSAGE_TEMPLATE_TYPES` const + type
- `CREW_TEMPLATE_VARIABLES`: `{{volunteerName}} {{eventName}} {{shiftName}} {{roleName}} {{shiftDate}} {{shiftTime}} {{location}} {{confirmUrl}} {{scheduleUrl}}` — with per-template list of which apply (custom_broadcast: volunteerName, eventName, scheduleUrl only; no confirmUrl)
- `getDefaultCrewMessageTemplate(type)` → {subject, body} — copy extracted to match the existing react-email components' current wording
- `renderCrewMessageTemplate({subject, body, variables})` → {subject, paragraphs: string[]} — pure `{{var}}` substitution, unknown vars left literal, body split on blank lines

### Generic email layout (apps/crew/src/react-email/crew/templated-message.tsx)
One react-email component matching the visual style of assignment-confirmation.tsx: renders subject/paragraphs + optional CTA button (label+url) + footer. All template types render through this going forward.

### Server fns (apps/crew/src/server-fns/crew-message-fns.ts) with heavy logic in apps/crew/src/server/crew-messages.server.ts
Auth: mirror the exact auth/authorization pattern used in crew-confirmation-fns.ts / crew-confirmation.server.ts (same operator requirement per eventId).

1. `getCrewMessageComposerFn({ eventId })` → `CrewMessageComposerData`:
   - `templates`: Array<{ templateType, subject, body, isCustomized }> (saved row or default)
   - `filterOptions`: { states: CrewAssignmentCommunicationState[], roles: {value,label}[], shifts: {id,name,startsAt}[] }
   - `history`: Array<{ id, kind: "confirmation"|"reminder"|"broadcast", subject/title, sentAt, recipientCount, delivered, failed }> — broadcasts from competitionBroadcastsTable (+recipient status counts, single GROUP BY like wodsmith-start listBroadcastsFn), plus summarized confirmation/reminder send batches derived from crew_assignment_confirmations (sentAt/reminder timestamps grouped by day is fine)
2. `saveCrewMessageTemplateFn({ eventId, templateType, subject, body })` → upsert; `resetCrewMessageTemplateFn({ eventId, templateType })` → delete row (back to default)
3. `previewCrewMessageRecipientsFn({ eventId, mode, filters })` → `{ recipients: CrewMessageRecipient[], skipped: {...} }`
   - mode: `assignment_confirmation | reminder | custom_broadcast`
   - filters: `{ states?: state[], roles?: string[], shiftIds?: string[], includeAlreadySent?: boolean, search?: string }`
   - `CrewMessageRecipient`: { assignmentId|confirmationId key, volunteerName, volunteerEmail|null, shiftName, roleLabel, startsAt, state, eligible: boolean, skipReason: "missing_email"|"already_sent"|"responded"|"not_due"|"past_shift"|null }
   - For custom_broadcast mode, recipients are unique volunteers (deduped by email) matching filters; eligibility just needs an email.
4. `queueCrewMessagesFn({ eventId, mode, recipientKeys: string[], template: {subject, body} })` → `{ queued, previewed, failed, eligible, queueAvailable }`
   - EXPLICIT recipient list (keys from preview) — server re-validates eligibility server-side; ignores stale/ineligible keys and reports them
   - Renders per-recipient via renderCrewMessageTemplate + templated-message layout; reuse the existing queue send path/idempotency conventions in crew-confirmation.server.ts (`crew-confirmation-${confirmationId}-${reminderCount}`; for custom broadcasts create a competitionBroadcastsTable row + recipients rows and reuse broadcast queue consumer conventions)
   - confirm/schedule token behavior for confirmation+reminder modes must stay identical to existing queueCrewAssignmentConfirmationEmails (mint raw token, store hash only)
   - Keep queue-unavailable → preview-count fallback behavior
5. Keep `getCrewAssignmentCommunicationDashboardFn` as-is (Responses tab still uses it). Do NOT break existing exports used by shifts.tsx.

## UI (apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/messages.tsx + -components/)

Tabs: **Compose** (default) | **Responses** (existing bucket dashboard, unchanged behavior incl. CSV export) | **History**.

Compose tab layout (2-col on lg, stacked mobile):
- Left: message type picker (4 templates as radio cards: Assignment invites / 48-hour reminder / 24-hour reminder / Custom message), subject input, body textarea, variable chips (click inserts `{{var}}` at cursor; only vars valid for that type), "Customized" badge + "Reset to default", Save template button, live preview pane rendering substituted sample values from a real recipient when available.
- Right: recipients panel — filters (state multi-select, role, shift, include-already-sent toggle, search), live-updating list w/ per-row checkbox, select-all-eligible, ineligible rows shown dimmed w/ skip reason, sticky footer "Send to N volunteers" → confirmation dialog (subject + N + skip summary) → send → toast with queued/previewed/failed → invalidate.
- Debounce recipient preview refetch on filter change.

History tab: list from `history` (kind badge, subject, sentAt in event tz, recipientCount, delivered/failed).

Style: match existing crew UI conventions in messages.tsx/shifts.tsx (plain tailwind, rounded-md border bg-card, no shadcn imports unless crew already uses them — check what messages.tsx uses today: plain elements + sonner toast + lucide icons). Timezone via formatDateTimeInTimezone with event timezone fallback "America/Denver".

## Non-goals
- No scheduling/drafts, no rich text, no athlete audiences (volunteers only), no SMS.

Contact updates write only volunteer roster metadata on `team_memberships`; they do not mutate user account email, assignment rows, confirmation response state, reminder counts, or sent timestamps.

## Assignment Confirmation Responses

Crew assignment confirmation links are token-only volunteer surfaces. Raw tokens are generated only while creating links, stored only as hashes, and used by [[apps/crew/src/routes/e/$slug/confirm/$token.tsx]] and [[apps/crew/src/routes/e/$slug/schedule/$token.tsx]] to show safe confirm, decline, and change-request flows without requiring a session.

[[apps/crew/src/server-fns/crew-confirmation-fns.ts]] owns token lookup, transient email payload construction, and deterministic response transitions. [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/assignment-confirmations.ts]] keeps the pure token and status helpers testable outside the server function layer.

## Assignment Confirmations

Organizer-facing assignment confirmations reuse `crew_assignment_confirmations` and keep assignments authoritative.

[[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/assignment-confirmations.ts]] normalizes operational states from persisted status plus timestamps: pending, sent, confirmed, declined, change requested, no-show, and replaced. Sent is represented by pending rows with `sentAt`, and replaced is represented by cancelled confirmation rows; checked-in waits for a later first-class primitive.

[[apps/crew/src/server/crew-confirmation.server.ts]] owns guarded organizer status updates for volunteer shift assignments, creating a confirmation row only when an assignment is missing one and never mutating assignment rows as part of status changes. [[apps/crew/src/server-fns/crew-confirmation-fns.ts]] keeps the createServerFn wrapper thin so DB/runtime imports stay out of route module graphs.

[[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/shifts.tsx]] shows compact assignment-level status controls and summary counts for sent and action-needed confirmations. Crew confirmation email operations use `crew_assignment_confirmations` as the source of truth for assignment response status, dispatch timestamps, and reminder counts.

[[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/assignment-confirmations.ts]] plans initial confirmation sends and 48-hour or 24-hour reminders from pending confirmation rows, normalized recipient emails, shift start times, `sentAt`, and `reminderCount`. Idempotency keys use `crew-confirmation-${confirmationId}-${reminderCount}` so queue retries do not double-send a reminder attempt.

[[apps/crew/src/server/crew-confirmation.server.ts]] loads eligible volunteer shift confirmations, mints fresh raw tokens only for the queued payload, stores only the new token hash, and builds rendered Crew email messages from [[apps/crew/src/react-email/crew/assignment-confirmation.tsx]], [[apps/crew/src/react-email/crew/reminder-48-hour.tsx]], and [[apps/crew/src/react-email/crew/reminder-24-hour.tsx]]. [[apps/crew/src/server-fns/crew-confirmation-fns.ts]] exposes the route-safe operation wrapper. [[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/shifts.tsx]] provides quiet operator actions for event-wide confirmation sends and reminder sends, then reports queued, previewed, and failed counts without sending live email during local validation.

Crew day-of operations is a compact read-only board for current blocks, response queues, role gaps, no-shows, replacements, and active judge lane coverage.

[[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/day-of.tsx]] renders the event board. [[apps/crew/src/server-fns/crew-day-of-fns.ts]] keeps the route import light while [[apps/crew/src/server/crew-day-of.server.ts]] reuses staffing hydration without mutating event data.

## Volunteer Messaging Composer

The Messages page is a broadcast-style composer: operators pick a message type, edit its email template, filter and hand-pick recipients with live eligibility preview, and send explicitly — replacing the earlier one-click bulk send buttons.

[[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/messages.tsx]] renders Compose, Responses, and History tabs driven by a `?tab=` search param. Compose pairs a template editor ([[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/messages-template-editor.tsx]]) with a recipients panel ([[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/messages-recipients-panel.tsx]]) orchestrated by [[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/messages-compose-tab.tsx]]: debounced recipient preview on filter change, checkbox selection with select-all-eligible, dimmed ineligible rows with skip reasons, and a confirm dialog before queueing. Responses ([[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/messages-responses-tab.tsx]]) preserves the prior confirmation bucket dashboard and CSV export unchanged. History ([[apps/crew/src/routes/events/$eventId/-components/messages-history-tab.tsx]]) lists confirmation, reminder, and broadcast sends with delivery counts.

### Message templates

Four per-event editable templates — assignment confirmation, 48-hour reminder, 24-hour reminder, and custom broadcast — with code-defined defaults matching the original email copy and `{{variable}}` substitution.

Overrides persist one row per `(competitionId, templateType)` in `crew_message_templates` ([[packages/wodsmith-db/src/schemas/crew-message-templates.ts]]); deleting the row resets to the default. [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/message-templates.ts]] owns template types, per-type variable lists, default copy, and the pure renderer that substitutes known variables, leaves unknown ones literal, and splits the body into paragraphs on blank lines. All templated sends render through the shared [[apps/crew/src/react-email/crew/templated-message.tsx]] layout.

### Filtered recipient selection

Recipient previews expand assignment confirmations (or unique volunteers for custom broadcasts) against filters — response state, role, shift, search, include-already-sent — and return per-row eligibility with skip reasons instead of silent exclusion.

[[apps/crew/src/server/crew-messages.server.ts]] resolves the composer payload (templates, filter options, history) and validates queue sends against an explicit recipient key list from the preview, re-checking eligibility server-side so stale selections are reported rather than sent. Confirmation and reminder sends keep the token-hash and idempotency conventions from [[crew#Confirmation Emails And Reminders]]; custom broadcasts write `competition_broadcasts` rows so history shares delivery status with the broadcast queue consumer. [[apps/crew/src/lib/crew/message-recipients.ts]] keeps the pure filter and eligibility logic testable outside the server layer.

## What `/events/$eventId/messages` is now

Three tabs (URL-driven via `?tab=`), modeled on the wodsmith-start announcements screen:

- **Compose** — pick one of four message types (Assignment invites, 48-hour reminder, 24-hour reminder, Custom message), edit its subject/body with click-to-insert `{{variable}}` chips and a live rendered preview using a real recipient's data, then filter recipients (response state, role, shift, search, include-already-sent) with a debounced live list. Ineligible rows show dimmed with skip reasons instead of vanishing. You check exactly who gets it, confirm in a dialog, and send.
- **Responses** — the previous confirmation bucket dashboard, preserved unchanged (including CSV export and the quick-send panels).
- **History** — confirmation, reminder, and broadcast sends with delivery counts.

Under the hood: template overrides persist per event in a new `crew_message_templates` table (delete = reset to default; defaults match the original email copy). Sends go through a new `queueCrewTemplatedAssignmentEmails` that reuses the existing eligibility plan, token-hash-only storage, and idempotency keys, and re-validates the explicit recipient list server-side so stale selections are reported, not sent. Custom broadcasts write real `competition_broadcasts` rows, riding the broadcast queue consumer crew already had ported but never used.
